cells.normalized_text: Suppressing an enemy grants +30 Weapons and 4% Forward Movement Speed Bonus for 10 seconds and refills the readied weapon. Incurs a 4 second cooldown before it can be reactivated. Killing Suppressed Enemies spawns a Void Breach.

sources.finding: Readied weapon refill transfers reserves without on-reload perks; +30 Weapons and 4% forward movement for ten seconds; suppressed kills create Breach. Its ten-second cooldown conflicts with the current sheet and official 8.1.0 and is not adopted.

sources.short_excerpt: Cooldown reduced from 11 seconds to 4 seconds.
sources.finding: Facet of Command / Echo of Domineering cooldown changed to four seconds on 2024-10-08.

sources.short_excerpt: Fixed an issue where the Echo of Domineering was not increasing the Weapons stat on activation.
sources.finding: 2026-01-27 fix confirms Weapons-stat activation; do not substitute old Mobility descriptions or the historical bug.

implemented: Shared actual status_applied credit triggers a four-second cooldown, ten-second +30 Weapons / +4% forward-ground contribution and refill of the currently drawn weapon from reserves.
Passive +10 Grenade is reduced once per holder, timed buffs are target-shared, and refill creates no reload_finished credit.
Suppressed kill qualification and position are read from the confirmed death history, surviving shared status cleanup and corpse removal; invokes the existing private Void Breach producer.
Separate bounded status/death receipt sets retain applications suppressed by cooldown and survive pure-session checkpoints and rebind.
Shared suppression_application accepts explicit NPC/Guardian durations, inspects the real target and uses world-authorized apply_status; death clears live suppression.
gaps: 正式Fragment/子职业装配、全部抑制生产者与来源例外（包括Bombardiers）尚未完成。验收用实际付费Shield Throw加合成命中施加器，不能称为Shield Throw原生具有抑制；目标敌对资格由上游生产者/世界授权负责，Fragment不在回调时猜测历史阵营。
前移加成已接真实地面输入和通用同步属性；完整D2绝对移动速度、ADS/持枪惩罚、上限、空中控制与换装手感仍需校准。+30 Weapons进入角色属性Profile，不代表全部武器动画/原型收益已接线。
四秒间隔、十秒收益和属性数值取原表；共享目标计时、空手/无可补弹量仍触发、解绑后已授收益继续、死亡清除活动收益而冷却继续计时，均为明确内容政策，原作边界仍待校准。
status_ids/death_ids在必填receipt_seconds内有限去重；十二秒为合成验收窗口，不是附加游戏冷却，也不是永久幂等或物理世界故障恢复。
Breach继续复用私有副本、五秒生成冷却与当前Class账户；测试0.444444归一化、.5/.75 CES及半米接触半径不代表完整原作校准。正式HUD、图标、动画、多人语义和跨维度/世界重启仍未完成。
